items.information: ![](https://i.imgur.com/Upxb5EP.png) Why SILENCE? We will be trying our best to provide you all with an ambience of as much as silence and serenity as possible! Irrespective of the events... Yes, Including 3x3 and other NxN events which don't generally demand silence. :) We aim to experiment and see how much more efficient we'd all be in an ambience more favorable for cubing. With minimal spectator pressure. We plan have separate rooms for waiting and competing, where the competing area would only have the competitors for the round, scramblers, and judges in it. We urge all the competitors to strictly adhere to the rules and regulations to contribute to the mission of providing a serene ambience for all the fellow cubers. If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, please bring your ID card as well. If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or not aware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the tutorial session. Happy cubing!

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. **ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades, apenas modalidades conhecidas como side events, portanto, não é uma competição indicada para iniciantes. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff. **ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of it's events, only the ones known as side events, that said, it is not a competition indicated for beginners

items.information: This is a series competition with [Pittsburgh Summer A 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PittsburghSummerA2022). You may only register for and compete in one of the two competitions. If you have already registered (with payment) for Pittsburgh Summer A 2022, your registration for this competition will be rejected. # Competitors may bring at most one guest. This will be checked at the entrance of the competition. No external spectators are allowed, only those coming with a confirmed competitor will be allowed in the venue. # All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of at least one of the following two requirements to be allowed in the venue: ##### 1) They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Sunday, July 31st is insufficient for entrance to the competition. ##### **OR** ##### 2) They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Wednesday, August 10th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. #### ##### Along with a full vaccination or negative test document, a valid ID must be shown and checked at the registration desk on the day of the competition. Any proof sent electronically to the organizers and/or delegates prior to the competition will not be accepted. #####

items.information: 8 años después de nuestra última competición, os presentanos el Rubik Mallorca Open 2022. Un torneo de speedcubing en esta maravillosa isla del mediterraneo donde podrás disfrutar de 2 días de competicion con rondas de casi todas las categorías oficiales, que se realizarán en el mismo hotel en que podrás hospedarte. En la edición de 2014 contamos con hasta 6 nacionalidades diferentes, y ahora ha llegado el momento de superarlo. ¡Os estaremos esperando! 8 years after our last competition, we are glad to present you the Rubik Mallorca Open 2022. A speedcubing tournament on this wonderful Mediterranean island where you'll be able to enjoy 2 days of competition with rounds of almost all official categories, which will take place in the same venue you'll stay. In the 2014 edition we had up to 6 different nationalities, and we plan to overcome it this year. So don't be afraid to join us. We'll be waiting for you!

items.information: REGISTRO A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos: 1. Tomar todos os cuidados referente ao COVID-19 e seguir o que será indicado pelo delegado e organizador da competição; 2. Conhecer as regras da WCA, pois é uma competição oficial; 3. Escolher os eventos a serem registrados com cuidado após revisar as guias Eventos e Cronograma. Preste atenção aos formatos das rodadas e seus cortes/limites; 4. Se inscrever através do site da WCA, realizar o pagamento de forma antecipada e mandar o comprovante para o organizador através do e-mail (joaoszme@yahoo.com.br) indicando o nome completo do participante; 5. Aguardar até que o registro eletrônico seja aceito. Caso não participe mesmo com o pagamento, não haverá devolução do dinheiro. Não serão aceitas inscrições no dia da competição; 6. Em virtude do COVID-19, o local só irá comportar um número máximo de 25 competidores e 25 convidados; 7. Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do e-mail (joaoszme@yahoo.com.br), bem como o delegado por meio do e-mail (blima@worldcubeassociation.org). REGISTRATION The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements: 1. Take all precautions regarding COVID-19 and follow what will be indicated by the delegate and the organizer; 2. Being familiar with the WCA rules, since this is an official competition; 3. Carefully choosing the events. Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind. 4. Register through the WCA website, pay in advance and send proof to the organizer via email (joaoszme@yahoo.com.br) indicating the participant's full name; 5. Wait for your registration to be approved online. In the case of not participating and having already paid the registration, no money will be returned. Registrations will not be accepted on the day of the competition; 6. Due to COVID-19, the venue will only hold a maximum of 25 competitors and 25 guests 7. For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (joaoszme@yahoo.com.br), or the delegate via email (blima@worldcubeassociation.org).

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdnNZIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--5dab4db532469b133dcb4913ae4f07994fbe1f39/LOGO_MP22_pro.png) Mistrzostwa Polski w Speedcubingu to najważniejsza impreza sezonu w kalendarzu każdego polskiego speedcubera. Od 2005 roku nieprzerwanie przyciąga najlepszych zawodników, którzy w atmosferze ducha fair play walczą o tytuł mistrza kraju we wszystkich oficjalnych konkurencjach World Cube Association. Po niezwykle udanej edycji 2021 Mistrzostwa Polski ponownie zostaną przeprowadzone w miejscu wyjątkowym jakim jest Olivia Star! Poraz kolejny rywalizacji na najwyższym poziomie będą towarzyszyły niesamowite widoki 34 piętra Olivia Star - największego wieżowca w północnej Polsce! --- Polish Speedcubing Championship is the most important event of the year of every Polish speedcuber. Since 2005 it continues to attract best competitors who compete for national titles in all events sanctioned by World Cube Association. After successful 2021 edition this year's championship will be held in a special place - Olivia Star! Once again competing at the highest level will be accompanied by amazing views from 34th floor of Olivia Star building - highest scyscraper in northern Poland!

items.information: Welcome to Mental Warm Up Arlanda 2022, held in Märsta, less than 10 kilometers from Stockholm Arlanda airport! Any dose received after Saturday, June 18th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. **OR** ##### -They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. items.name: Oslo Open 2022
items.information: ## Informasjon Norsk: Velkommen til Oslo Open 2022! Dette er den første kube konkuransen i Oslo siden 2015! Vi gleder oss! Du melder deg på konkurransen online. Hvis du ikke har en WCA konto må du først lage en [her](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). Påmeldingen åpner lørdag 28. mai kl 16:00 norsk tid. Det koster 150 NOK å delta. Prisen inkluderer et måltid med mat og drikke på lørdag. Det er kort vei til matbutikker og take away tilbud i nærområdet. Vi følger lokale koronarestriksjoner. Pr dd er det ingen særlige krav eller restriksjoner i Oslo. ## Information English: Welcome to Oslo Open 2022! This is the first cube competition in Oslo since 2015! You can register for the competition online. If you don’t have a WCA account you can make one [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). The registration opens Saturday 28 of May at 6:00 PM Norwegian time. We follow local Covid restrictions. As of today, there are no special requirements or restrictions in Oslo.

items.information: [FR] En accord avec la politique de santé publique et les directives de l'ÉTS, tous les compétiteurs et leurs accompagnateurs devront porter un masque à l'intérieur des bâtiments. Le port du couvre-visage en tissu est interdit. Dans l'éventualité où les directives changent, les compétiteurs seront avisés par courriel. Portez une attention particulière à l'onglet Santé & Sécurité. **Les étudiants de l'ÉTS peuvent s'inscrire sans frais**. Si vous êtes étudiant de l'ÉTS, vous devez réserver votre place sur le [portail de réservation](https://reservation.etsmtl.ca/Accueil.aspx) dans monÉTS dans la section "Activités de la vie étudiante". Vous devez enregistrer au plus tard le vendredi 15 avril à 15h. Une fois que c'est fait j'aurais la liste des étudiants qui n'auront pas besoin de payer. Vous devez donc ensuite vous inscrire sur le site web WCA en même temps que tout le monde, simplement vous n'aurez pas à payer les frais d'inscription. Je précise que vous devez enregister le plus tôt possible, car être enregistré sur le portail de réservation ne vous garantie pas une place dans la compétition. Il n'y aura **aucun remboursement en cas d'annulation** (à cause des frais de transaction). Cependant si vous vous inscrivez et que vous n'êtes finalement pas en mesure de venir, merci de nous en informer afin de donner la place à quelqu'un d'autre. Les personnes inscrites en file d'attente seront remboursées une fois la période d'inscription s'est fermée. [EN] As per the current public health policy and the directives of the university, all competitors and their guest must wear a mask at all time inside the buildings. items.information: # REGISTRO A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos: 1. O acesso ao local será permitido mediante comprovação de esquema vacinal completo, ou teste negativo para Covid-19 do tipo PCR, realizado até 48 horas antes do ingresso no local, ou do tipo antígeno, realizado até 24 horas antes do ingresso no estabelecimento (para o competidor e o acompanhante). Para as crianças menores de 12 anos, será solicitado o teste negativo de Covid-19 do tipo PCR, realizado até 48 horas antes do ingresso no estabelecimento, ou do tipo antígeno, realizado até 24 horas antes do acesso ao local. Register through the WCA website.The registration fee is R$25,00 (registration+shirt) paid in advance by bank transfer or Pix. Registration at competition day will not be allowed. Bank Account: Itau Bank | Ag. 7021 | CC 05400-7 -> Pix 103552998-01. 5. For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (antonio.cecchini@gmail.com), or the delegate via email (pmiranda@worldcubeassociation.org). Access to the venue will be allowed upon proof of the complete vaccination schedule, or a negative test for Covid-19 of the PCR type, took up to 48 hours before entering the venue, or of the antigen type, took up to 24 hours before entry into the establishment (for both competitor and companion). For children under 12 years of age, a negative Covid-19 PCR test will be required, took within 48 hours before entering the establishment, or an antigen test took within 24 hours before entering the venue. items.information: Day 1 (April 1st) will be located in the Senate Chamber of the Ohio Union. The Senate Chamber is on the west side of the second floor next to the Archie M Griffin West Ballroom. If you need help locating the Senate Chamber, there is a help desk on the first floor, as well as multiple maps around the building. Days 2 and 3 (April 2nd and 3rd) will be located in the East Auditorium of the Rhodes Center at the Ohio Expo Center. A map of the expo center will be provided in the **Travel** tab. **Day 1:** 3x3x3 Fewest Moves **Day 2:** 5x5x5 Cube, 6x6x6 Cube, 7x7x7 Cube, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Square-1, Face-Turning Octahedron, Mirror Blocks **Day 3:** 3x3x3 Cube, 2x2x2 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, Pyraminx, Skewb Due to venue constraints, we will be enforcing a competitor limit of **38** for 3x3x3 Fewest Moves on a first come, first serve basis. Competitors may bring at most one guest. This will be checked at the entrance of the competition. All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of at least one of the following two requirements to be allowed in the venue: 1) They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Friday, March 18th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. OR 2) They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Monday, March 28th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. **Refund Information: Due to venue financial requirements, no refunds will be issued after March 3rd, 2022 unless there are extreme circumstances. These circumstances include the following: ** * **Competitor contracts COVID-19 within 14 days of the competition and must withdraw** * **Other Injury or Sickness that would prevent the competitor from attending** * **Competition as a whole is cancelled** * **Any specific excuse deemed acceptable by an organizer or delegate** **We understand that some may need to cancel their registration after the refund date due to unforseen events or circumstances; however, due to financial constraints, we will only be refunding competitors if they meet one of the previously mentioned conditions. We thank you for your understanding.**

Hay un límite de 30 competidores para el registro. * Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes. * Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad, a nuevos y viejos competidores, sin importar los tiempos de resolución. * Por razones sanitarias, no estarán permitidos los acompañantes a menos que sea necesario y esté justificado debidamente (p.ej. menores de edad). Máximo un acompañante por persona. * La competencia funcionará de acuerdo a la [Política de Seguridad de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf), por lo tanto es importante que la lean para evitar inconvenientes, además, se debe tener en cuenta que el Delegado de la WCA puede descalificar a cualquier competidor cuyo comportamiento constituya un riesgo para la salud de los demás. No se realizan reembolsos por descalificación, según la regla [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1) del Reglamento de la WCA. * Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles. * Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la categoría, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento. * Leer toda la información disponible en esta página. **¡Importante!** **La competencia puede ser cancelada por la Junta Directiva de la WCA si la situación de la pandemia empeora.** Ante cualquier duda consultar al organizador o el Delegado de la WCA. **English:** YOU MUST NOT SHOW UP AT THE COMPETITION WITH SYMPTOMS OF THE COVID-19. Competitor limit: 30. * Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue. * This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age. * For safety reasons, guests won't be allowed inside the venue, unless a competitor requires a guest for any justified reason (e.g. minors). Only one guest per competitor allowed. * This competition will be held in accordance with the [WCA Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf). Please, remember that the WCA Delegate may disqualify any competitor that behaves in a way that is unsafe for other people's health inside the venue (see regulation [2k3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k3)). A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition (regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1)). Please read the WCA Safety Policy to avoid any issue. * Competitors must provide their own puzzles. * Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with the article [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations. * Read all the information available in this website. **Attention!** **The competition may be canceled by the WCA Board if the pandemic situation gets worse.** For any question, feel free to contact the organizer or the WCA Delegate.

items.information: Popping Off Pukekohe B 2022 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. Please note this is a **twin competition**. To make it fairer and more accessible to more competitiors during the current covid-19 restrictions, you will only be allowed to register for one competition - not both. Please check the event list and timings to see which day you would like to register for as there will be different events on different days. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdDBTIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--9c60c69f55d7d13ebdef41c77a97666ab1541c88/PukekoheBWhiteBG.png)

You may only register for and compete in one of the two competitions. If you have already registered (with payment) for Empire State Winter B 2022, your registration for this competition will be rejected. # Competitors may bring at most one guest. This will be checked at the entrance of the competition. # All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of at least one of the following two requirements to be allowed in the venue: ##### 1) They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Saturday, January 1st is insufficient for entrance to the competition. ##### **OR** ##### 2) They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Tuesday, January 11th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. #### ##### Along with a full vaccination or negative test document, a valid ID must be shown and checked at the registration desk on the day of the competition. Any proof sent electronically to the organizers and/or delegates prior to the competition will not be accepted. #####

items.name: Güemes Open 2022
items.information: Güemes Open 2022 es la primera competencia que se va a realizar en la provincia de Salta, Argentina, y a su vez, la primera competencia del 2022 del país! El objetivo de esta competencia es reactivar la comunidad norteña del país. Nos esforzaremos en hacer cumplir todos los protocolos pertinentes a la pandemia. Competidores, recuerden ser puntuales, siguiendo los horarios del cronograma. Recomendamos llegar 20 minutos antes para evitar inconvenientes, en especial a los nuevos competidores. Este torneo contará con 11 categorias oficiales y tendrá una duración de 2 días. *LEER LOS SIGUIENTES APARTADOS* https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GuemesOpen2022/#17047-protocolos https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GuemesOpen2022/#16994-payment-pago https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GuemesOpen2022#17085-requisitos-para-entrar-a-salta A pesar de no tener restricciones estrictas con la cantidad de personas que puede asistir y que el lugar es abierto y ventilado, recomendamos no llevar mas de 2 acompañantes para reducir al máximo los riesgos Güemes Open 2022 is the first competition to be held in the province of Salta, Argentina, and also, the first competition of 2022 in the country! The objective of this competition is to reactivate the northern community of the country. We will endeavor to enforce all protocols relevant to the pandemic. Competitors, remember to be punctual, following schedule. We recommend arriving 20 minutes before to avoid inconvenience, especially to new competitors. This tournament will have 11 official categories and will last 2 days. *READ THE FOLLOWING TABS* https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GuemesOpen2022/#17047-protocolos https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GuemesOpen2022/#16994-payment-pago https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GuemesOpen2022#17085-requisitos-para-entrar-a-salta Despite not having strict restrictions with the number of people who can attend and that the place is open and ventilated, we recommend not to bring more than 2 companions to minimize the risks

items.information: As per BC's recently announced [Proof of Vaccination Requirement](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/covid-19/vaccine/proof), All attendees are required to have **FULL vaccination (2 doses)** by the event date otherwise, you will NOT be allowed to enter the venue. Note that this is a **one of a pair of series competitions**. Series competitions (formerly known as twin competitions) are relatively new to BC. Please see the Series Competiton Tab for more information. Take clear note especially of the Health and Safety Tab, containing our Risk Mitigation Plan. Note: **Spectators (max 1 per competitor)** can attend for free. Those aged 18+ are invited to consider not attending with a guest to help our venue capacity numbers as low as possible. **If you're not a competitor, nor the single guest of a competitor, then we ask you NOT to come.** Note: As the pandemic is an ever-evolving situation, there is of course the possibility that we will need to increase safety precautions or, in the worst case, cancel the competition. **Please be aware that changes may be needed.** Email will be sent out to registered competitors about significant changes. In the event of cancellation we will do our best to provide full refunds to everyone.

items.information: **[FR]** **Suite aux annonces par le gouvernement du Québec sur le [Passeport vaccinal](https://www.quebec.ca/sante/problemes-de-sante/a-z/coronavirus-2019/deroulement-vaccination-contre-la-covid-19/passeport-de-vaccination-covid-19/lieux-et-activites-exigeant-passeport-vaccinal-covid-19), tous les compétiteurs et leurs accompagnateurs devront présenter leur passeport vaccinal et une pièce d'identité avec photo à l'entrée du site de compétition. L'accès à la compétition sera refusé à tous ceux qui ne peuvent présenter un passeport valide. Un questionnaire d'accueil devra également être rempli au préalable, voir l'[onglet Preuve de vaccination](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TroisRivieres2021#16692-preuve-de-vaccination-vaccination-proof) pour plus de détails. Dans l'éventualité où les directives gouvernementales changent, les compétiteurs seront avisés par courriel.** Également, il est à noter que **les citoyens étrangers qui désirent voyager au Canada doivent être admissibles au statut de [voyageurs entièrement vaccinés](https://voyage.gc.ca/voyage-covid/voyage-restrictions/voyageurs-vaccines-covid-entrent-canada) et suivre les instructions détaillées sur le site du gouvernement canadien.** Veuillez lire **tous les onglets** sur cette page web. C'est très important. En raison de la COVID-19, **il y aura des nouveautés même pour les compétiteurs chevronnés**. Portez une attention particulière à l'[onglet Santé & Sécurité](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TroisRivieres2021#16495-sante-securite-health-safety) ainsi qu'à notre [Plan d'atténuation des risques](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1J-chgIfmLQXCUG1fXK5kZr0Bovynngmy/view?usp=sharing) conforme aux directives de la WCA. Note : **un (1) accompagnateur maximum par compétiteur**. Si vous n'êtes pas un compétiteur ou accompagnateur, nous vous demandons de ne pas venir. Note : Dans le cas où la situation en lien avec la pandémie COVID-19 devient drastiquement pire et que les directives changent, il se peut que la WCA annule la compétition. Les mises à jour importantes seront affichées sur ce site et envoyées directement par courriel aux compétiteurs. **[EN]** **As per the Quebec government's recently announced [Proof of Vaccination Requirement](https://www.quebec.ca/en/health/health-issues/a-z/2019-coronavirus/progress-of-the-covid-19-vaccination/covid-19-vaccination-passport/places-and-activities-requiring-covid-19-vaccination-passport), all competitors and their (single) guest must present a valid proof of vaccination and a valid piece of ID with photo in order to enter the venue. Also, a welcome questionnaire will have to be filled, see the [Vaccination proof tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TroisRivieres2021#16692-preuve-de-vaccination-vaccination-proof) for more details. We will send registered competitors further details in an email if the government updates its regulations.** Moreover, note that **individuals arriving from outside of Canada need to qualify as [fully vaccinated travellers](https://travel.gc.ca/travel-covid/travel-restrictions/covid-vaccinated-travellers-entering-canada) and follow the canadian government policies detailed on the website.** Please **review ALL of the tabs listed on this website**. This is a priority. **Even if you are a seasoned competitor, COVID-19 has created some new conditions** and there are things to be particularly attentive to. Take clear note especially of the [Health and Safety Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TroisRivieres2021#16495-sante-securite-health-safety) and our full WCA-compliant [Risk Mitigation Plan](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1J-chgIfmLQXCUG1fXK5kZr0Bovynngmy/view?usp=sharing). Note: **Only one (1) spectator per competitor** can attend. **If you're not a competitor or the single guest of a competitor, then we ask you NOT to come.** Note: **In the unlikely event that the COVID-19 situation concerningly worsens**, the WCA may step in and cancel the competition. Significant updates such as these will be posted here on the website and emailed to registered competitors.

Contamos con la experiencia de haber organizado el primer torneo en la zona (Patagonia Open 2019) con gran éxito. Se ruega mucha puntualidad. It will have 12 events and 21 rounds in total. Our goal is to let the competitors show their progress during the lockdown and to reactivate the competitions all over the country. We have the experience of having organized the first tournament on the region (Patagonia Open 2019) with great success. Please be very punctual. Slutligen vill vi påminna om att COVID-19 situationen är mycket osäker, och att sena förändringar inklusive att tävlingen ställs in med kort varsel tyvärr inte går att utesluta. Håll därför nära koll på denna hemsida samt er email för att få den senaste informationen och kom ihåg att arrangörerna endast kan återbetala anmälningsavgiften, inte personliga reseutgifter.

items.information: This is the fourth Copper Country Cubing competition, and we're looking forward to welcoming you to the Michigan Upper Peninsula! It's been a long time since anyone has been able to compete, so this event features two long events on Saturday evening and the more common NxN events on Sunday. We plan to host another competition this Fall with more of the non-NxN puzzles, so look out for it! As this competition takes place on the Michigan Technology University campus, it is subject to Michigan state laws, University campus policies, and WCA policies. We will monitor all of these sources for any changes to safety protocols and requirements. Please note that if community or regional health problems surface again or severely worsen, the competition may be forced to cancel. There is a 40 person Competitor Limit for this competition. Please sign up early to ensure a spot, and please read the "Waiting List" tab for additional information on registration for the competition. If the competition is running ahead of schedule and has enough competitors we would love to add an additional round to 3BLD, 3OH, and/or 6x6. Additionally, please note that the rounds are scheduled with more time than usual to account for stationary groups and sanitation time. **YOU MUST READ THE COVID SAFETY TAB PRIOR TO REGISTERING.**

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador (conforme previsto no Regulamento da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Competidores baianos terão preferência para receber prêmios nos eventos. Caso não tenham três competidores baianos com resultados válidos em um evento, outros competidores poderão receber prêmios, respeitada a preferência dos competidores da Bahia. --------------------------------------------------------------- Registration is open to all, of all nationalities. Aiming at the smooth running of the competition, when registering, you also make yourself available to help as a judge or scrambler (as stated in the WCA Regulations). This is a way for the competition to become sustainable, and the tasks are shared between all competitors, not becoming a heavy load just for a few. Competitors from Bahia will have a preference for receiving prizes in the events. If there aren't three competitors from Bahia with valid results in an event, other competitors will be eligible to receive prizes, respecting the preference of competitors from Bahia.

items.information: **English:** CubingAT is happy to announce the first official WCA competition in Salzburg, the Salzburg Open 2020. Fortunately, we found a very strong, dynamic and cool partner (HTBLuVA Salzburg), that finally gave us the possibility to solve some cubes in Salzburg. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. All guests are welcome, but to maintain the security, we would like you to let us know you’re coming. Simply write us your name to this e-mail address: competitions@cubing.at. Alternatively, if you accompany a competitor, they can write your name in the comment of their registration. ___ **Deutsch:** Wir von CubingAT freuen uns sehr euch in der HTBLuVA Salzburg, bei den ersten Salzburg Open 2020 begrüßen zu können. Dank der hervorragenden Zusammenarbeit mit dem routinierten, dynamischen und vor allem aufgeschlossenen Team der HTBLuVA, dürfen wir Speedcuber auch endlich mal in Salzburg Würfel (schnell) lösen. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.information: Vous n'êtes pas obligé d'arriver au moment de l'enregistrement, nous vous accepterons sans aucun problème si vous arrivez dans la journée. Essayez simplement d'être là au moins 30 minutes avant votre première épreuve. Une pièce d'identité vous sera demandée si c'est votre première compétition. **Merci de nous prévenir par e-mail si finalement vous ne pouvez pas participer à la compétition.** **REPAS** : Les samedi soir et dimanche soir, nous vous proposons un repas collectif et des jeux, sur le lieu de la compétition. Samedi soir, pour 10€ : * Des diots (saucisse de porc Savoyarde) et des crozets (une alternative végétarienne/végétalienne devrait être disponible, merci de nous le préciser) * Un dessert, incluant des gourdes de compote de pomme ou des fruits, un yaourt et peut-être un gateau Dimanche soir pour 15€ : * Une grande pizza (au choix, commande le jour J) * Un dessert, comme le samedi **LASER GAME** : Le samedi soir, nous allons au Laser Game ensemble, nous arrangerons les voitures avec les personnes présentes. Nous avons la grande salle, de 21h50 à minuit pour 2 parties de 45 minutes. Vous pouvez participer aux deux pour 28€ (à régler au Laser Game) ou une pour 15€. Merci de préciser dans la section "Commentaire" de votre inscription si vous comptez venir, et si vous êtes accompagnés, car il y a un nombre limité de places ! --- You are not obliged to be here at registration time, we will accept you if you come during the day. Try to be here at least 30 minutes before your first event. We will have the main room from 21h50 to midnight for two 45 minute games. You can play in both for 28€ (to pay at the Laser Game) or one for 15€. items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.information: Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna auto-sustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Aiming to a good fluence for the competition, at registering for a event, you compromise to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in the other you'll help as staff.

items.information: (HR) Croatian Nationals 2019 je trinaesto natjecanje po redu koje se održava u Hrvatskoj od 2011. godine. Bilo tko može sudjelovati, bez obzira na nacionalnost i starost, no svatko mora biti upoznat s WCA Pravilnikom. Natjecanje je pod organizacijom Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska. Kotizacija pokriva trošak organizacije i najma prostora. Mogući višak kotizacije ide u svrhu razvitka Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska. Članovi Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska ostvaruju 25% popusta na kotizaciju. Također, natjecanje je priznato kao Nacionalno Prvenstvo te će se dijeliti nagrade za najbolja 3 Hrvata u svim disciplinama. -------------- (EN) Croatian Nationals 2019 is the 13th speedcubing competition being held in Croatia since 2011. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations. This competition is being organized by the Speedcubing Association Croatia. Registration fee covers the cost of the organization and venue rental. Any extra money goes directly to support Speedcubing Association Croatia. Members of Speedcubing Association Croatia have 25% discount on the registration fee. This competition is also recognized as Croatian National Championship and top 3 Croatians in all events will be additionally awarded, alongside regular podiums.

items.name: Oceania 10th Anniversary 2019

venue.name: [Wellington College](https://www.wellington-college.school.nz/facility-hire)
venue.address: 15 Dufferin St, Mount Victoria, Wellington 6021, New Zealand

items.information: Following the first competition in Oceania (New Zealand Championships 2009), speedcubing exploded in popularity across the continent. Now, ten years later, we're holding a competition to celebrate the growth of the community, and everything we've achieved over that period. Oceania 10th Anniversary 2019 returns to Wellington, the site of that first competition, and marks almost exactly ten years since then. Additionally, this is the first competition of the "Cubing Down Under Tour" - a tightly scheduled series of competitions across Oceania, leading up to WCA World Championship 2019, in Melbourne. This should build hype for the World Championship, and, (especially for foreign competitors) provide an excellent opportunity to experience more of the continent. For more information, visit the [travel page](https://wc2019.speedcubing.org.au/en/travel) of the World Championship website.

items.information: Los resultados de este torneo ingresarán a la base de datos y al ranking de la WCA, y quienes participen por primera vez adquirirán un perfil oficial. Por esa razón, todos los competidores deben conocer el reglamento de la WCA. REGISTRO: El registro se considera completo cuando se ha completado el registro electrónico y se ha realizado el pago (precio y métodos de pago explicados en la sección de requisitos de registro). Cada competidor debe elegir los eventos en los que se va a inscribir cuidadosamente luego de revisar la pestaña “Horario" (Schedule). Prestar atención a los formatos de cada ronda y a sus respectivos cortes y límites detallados en la pestaña “Categorías” (Events). Es importante escribir cuidadosamente los nombres, fecha de nacimiento o demás datos. En caso de no hacerlo de la manera correcta, serán rechazados. Para competidores que participan por segunda vez es necesario que hayan reclamado su WCA ID. *Los competidores que vengan de fuera de Lima deberán comunicarse y coordinar la forma de pago directamente con la tienda Speedcuber Perú al 991817714 o al 7505980. El registro permanecerá abierto hasta el jueves 18 de abril o y hasta que se alcance el límite de competidores. Sin embargo, **solo tendrán derecho a recibir polo quienes completen su registro (inscripción y pago) antes del 06 de abril.**

items.name: No Place For DNF Spring 2019
items.information: The main event of this competition is 3x3 Fewest Moves. -We recommend that you arrive at least 15 minutes before your first event because there are no set times for each group. If your first event is later in the day, you do not have to arrive until then. If you miss your group, you will be disqualified from that event. -Groups will be posted and sent in an email a few days before the competition. When it is time to compete, groups will be called instead of individual participants. -Food and drinks are **NOT** permitted inside the main room. You may eat in the cafeteria next door.There are a few restaurants within a ten minute drive. -Live results will be posted on cubecomps.com. -All proceeds from the competition will be donated to the No Place for Hate® club of Emmaus High School. Proceeds will not be donated to ADL directly. -CubeDepot will sponsor the competition and will be a vendor! **A local newspaper photographer will be taking pictures of the competition. If you would not like to have your picture taken, please let us know.** **Please observe silence during FMC and blindfold events.** **This competition will not be holding the famous 3x3 speedsolve event. We still encourage newer competitors to try out other events!**

items.information: Este torneo es la séptima edición del Aventura Cúbica. Los resultados de este torneo ingresarán a la base de datos y al ranking de la WCA, y quienes participen por primera vez adquirirán un perfil oficial. Por esa razón, todos los competidores deben conocer el reglamento de la WCA. REGISTRO: Se debe realizar el pago en la tienda TCG (The Cube Girls) de Lima, ubicada en Galería Brasil, Av. Brasil 1275, interior 66-A, Jesús María (http://thecubegirls.com/index.php/tiendas). Cada competidor debe elegir los eventos en los que se va a inscribir cuidadosamente luego de revisar la pestaña “Horario" (Schedule). Prestar atención a los formatos de cada ronda y a sus respectivos cortes y límites detallados en la pestaña “Categorías” (Events). Es importante escribir cuidadosamente los nombres, fecha de nacimiento o demás datos. En caso de no hacerlo de la manera correcta, serán rechazados. Para competidores que participan por segunda vez es necesario que hayan reclamado su WCA ID. *Los competidores que vengan de fuera de Lima deberán comunicarse y coordinar la forma de pago con el organizador, Alexander Esquivel CEL: 982527214. El registro permanecerá abierto mientras no se alcance el límite de competidores. Sin embargo, solo tendrán derecho a recibir polo quienes completen su registro (inscripción y pago) antes del 02 de febrero.

items.information: Дополнительная информация будет публиковаться в нашей [группе Вконтакте](https://vk.com/ksfustkamenogorskcity2019). Перед подачей заявки ознакомьтесь с информацией о регистрации. Регистрация с неправильно введенным именем и фамилией не будут приняты, пожалуйста внимательно проверьте внесенные данные. Подача заявки и оплата взноса за участие или входного билета гостя/зрителя означает, что Вы ознакомлены и согласны с правилами проведения чемпионата Если вы ознакомились с условиями регистрации и условиями оплаты взноса на вкладке "Как оплатить участие (Payment information)", то вы можете перейти к регистрации. ВНИМАНИЕ!!! 1. Если участник приходит без совершеннолетнего сопровождающего, то он обязан при себе иметь письменное заявление-согласие от родителей либо опекунов, о том, что они самостоятельно несут ответственность за несовершеннолетнего ребенка. 2. Головоломки используемые в соревнованиях должны иметь отличительные отметки, по которым их легко может идентифицировать владелец (например: нацарапанные инициалы или имя с внутренней стороны съемной крышки) ====================================================== После оплаты взноса ваша фамилия появится на сайте. Это означает что ваша заявка принята. Если вы не оплатили взнос, то примерно за 1-2 недели до соревнований вы получите письмо с напоминанием о необходимости оплатить взнос для подтверждения своего участия. Обязательно проверяйте свой ящик и спам. Если вы не оплатите взнос, то Ваша заявка не будет принята. Если Вы подали заявку и оплатили взнос, но в течении 2-х рабочих дней ее не подтвердили, сразу обратитесь к организаторам (не считая выходные дни). В день соревнований участнику и гостю при себе нужно иметь документ удостоверяющий личность. For more info please visit our [VK Group](https://vk.com/ksfustkamenogorskcity2019). Before submitting the application, read the registration information. Registration with incorrect first and last name will not be accepted, please carefully check the entered data. Submitting an application and paying a participation fee or a guest / viewer entrance ticket means that you acquainted and agree with the rules of the championship If you have read the terms of registration and the terms of payment of the fee in the tab "How to pay / How to pay for participation", then you can proceed to registration. **ATTENTION!!! 1. If a participant under 18 years old attends the competition without adult, he must have written application from parents or legal guardians that they are responsible for their child. 2. Puzzles used in competitions must have distinctive marks by which the owner can easily identify them (for example, scratched initials or the name on the inside of the removable cover) ** After paying the fee, your name will appear on the site. This means that your application has been accepted. If you did not pay the fee, then approximately 1-2 weeks before the competition you will receive an email with a reminder to pay a fee to confirm your participation. Be sure to check your box and spam. If you do not pay the fee, your application will not be accepted. If you submitted an application and paid the fee, but it was not confirmed within 2 business days, contact the organizers immediately (not counting the weekend). On the day of the competition, the participant and the guest need to have an identity document.
